_about: The owner's corrections to the organ's registration score (tools/artfugue/registration.py). Written over what the rule made: { "c01": { "2": [[start_s, end_s, "flute"]] } } means that in Contrapunctus I voice 2 plays the flute from start_s to end_s (seconds on the recording's timeline, as the player's clock shows them). Ranks are "full" or "flute". Then run: python -m artfugue.registration (and pnpm data or the fingerprint step, so that the browsers fetch the new file).
